name: LehmannLabs WebP Optimizer
author: lehmannlabs

sections.description:
LehmannLabs WebP Optimizer is focused on one core goal: faster page load times.

The plugin converts your WordPress images to WebP and serves WebP files on the frontend whenever available. This reduces image payload and helps improve Core Web Vitals and user experience.

It was developed for WordPress websites built with Elementor and works well with typical Elementor image output (including image widgets, carousels, and background image use cases).

Unlike many plugins in this category, LehmannLabs WebP Optimizer is fully free to use, with no advertising, no tracking, and no premium upsells. Many competing plugins are either limited in their free version or are generally only available as paid products.

Tested with:
– Elementor v3.35.6
– Elementor Pro v3.35.1

Key benefits:
– Faster frontend image delivery through WebP replacement
– Completely free, with no ads and no paid upgrades
– No feature limits in the free version and no paid-only core workflow
– Optional auto-conversion on upload
– Batch conversion for existing media
– Safe fallback strategy and backup/restore tools
– No external API calls, no tracking

Main features:
– WebP generation for full-size and intermediate image sizes
– Output modes:
– Picture mode (recommended): WebP source with fallback image
– Direct mode: direct URL/srcset replacement to WebP when available
– Original image backup to uploads/slimage-backup/YYYY/MM/
– Optional resize with configurable maximum edge length
– Batch tools in wp-admin:
– Scan & Optimize
– Delete WebP Files
– Restore Originals
– Site Health integration for WebP capability checks
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/lehmannlabs-webp-optimizer/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Open LehmannLabs WebP > Settings and review options.
  4. Use LehmannLabs WebP > Tools for batch actions.
sections.faq:
Are originals deleted?

No. Originals are preserved in uploads/slimage-backup/ while backup is enabled.

What happens if WebP is not supported on the server?

The plugin skips WebP generation and reports this in Site Health and admin notices.

Can I restore optimized files?

Yes. You can restore per attachment or in batches.

Can I delete the backup folder manually from the plugin?

Yes. Use the “Delete Backup Now” button in LehmannLabs WebP > Settings.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. The plugin was developed for WordPress with Elementor and is optimized for common Elementor image output patterns.
